title: Fraction Multiplication
topic: Multiplying Fractions with Fractions and Whole Numbers
subject: Mathematics

questions.question: Ali spent 2/7 of his money. If he spent $24, how much money did he have at first?
questions.explanation: 2/7 of total = $24. So 1/7 of total = $24 / 2 = $12. Total = $12 x 7 = $84

questions.question: Find the value of 4/5 x 15/16.
questions.explanation: 4/5 x 15/16. Cancel: 4 and 16 share factor 4 (gives 1/4), 5 and 15 share factor 5 (gives 3/1). So = (1 x 3) / (1 x 4) = 3/4

questions.question: Sarah had some stickers. She gave 3/8 of them to her friend and had 45 stickers left. How many stickers did she have at first?
questions.explanation: She gave away 3/8, so she had 5/8 left. 5/8 of total = 45. So 1/8 of total = 45 / 5 = 9. Total = 9 x 8 = 72 stickers.

questions.question: Find the product of 7/8 and 4/7.
questions.explanation: 7/8 x 4/7. Cancel: 7 in numerator and denominator cancel. 4 and 8 share factor 4. So = (1 x 1) / (2 x 1) = 1/2

questions.question: A tank is 2/3 full. If it contains 480 litres, what is the full capacity of the tank?
questions.explanation: 2/3 of full capacity = 480 litres. So 1/3 of full capacity = 480 / 2 = 240 litres. Full capacity = 240 x 3 = 720 litres.
